notes.title: Virtualcast ver 2.7.3a released
notes.content:
Virtual Cast App
System Update

The base system for Virtual Cast, Unity, has been updated to Unity 6.

Spec Changes

The preset characters "Repair" and "Sienta" have been added. The default character has also been changed from "The Boy" to "Repair." "The Boy" is still available as a preset character.
In rooms, the deployment of new VCI items is now temporarily paused while a location loads. VCI items will now appear after the location display effect is complete.

Functional Improvements

Improved the operational stability of rooms where multiple VCI cameras for taking photos are placed.

Wan-Kome Integration

Wan-Kome OSC Plugin ver 1.2.1 has been released.
Fixed an issue where special characters such as '', and '&' were not being correctly replaced when receiving comments containing multiple such characters.

The folder structure of the plugin has been changed. When updating, please replace the entire folder instead of overwriting its contents.

For more information on installing the plugin, please see here.

ニコニコ連携復旧対応
ニコニコサービス再開に伴い、バーチャルキャスト連携機能の復旧対応を行っております。

notes.content:
Overall
The System Update
As announced earlier in the service development progress briefings, we made an update on the base system.

 Updated Unity to version 2022.
 Changed the rendering system from the Built-in Render Pipeline to the new Universal Render Pipeline.
 We introduced and explained these updates in detail in the service development progress briefings held on 22 June 2022 and 28 September 2022.
 For information on the new rendering system, refer to here (Japanese).

 Fixed some expressions and effects in the title scene.

Changes

 Meta information is now written to the photo file when a photo is taken.
 More detail on the meta information can be found here (Japanese article). 
 Adjusted the stream camera's tally lamp bloom effect to be weaker, making it easier to see the monitor on the stream camera. 

Adjustments

 Updated VIVE eye tracking and face tracking libraries.
 This requires the latest version of SR Runtime.
 For the latest version of the SR Runtime update, please visit the  VIVE Developer page.
 Also, please check here for information on using eye tracking and face tracking.
Studio
Improvements

 Optimized the V gift generation process

 Videos taken with video capture are now saved with file names representing the date and time when the capture process ended.
 Pictures/videos taken with the Capture camera/Video capture are now saved in %userprofile%\Pictures\VirtualCast\Media\{YYYY-MM} folders.

Room
New Features

 The download progress will be shown while the room is loaded.

Changes/Improvements

 When you reload a VCI, the ring menu will now go back to the item list menu. This will solve the issue where different VCI might spawn in cases between when you create a new item and reload an existing one.
 Adjusted the design on the calibration scene.
 Optimized the memory management around the photo capture.
 Improved the stability of the server when using the RUDP.
 Changed how the sound volume of each VCI is handled: you can now change the volume of all instances of the same VCI at once.

 Fixed the issue where you couldn't touch other avatars' SpringBone.
 Fixed the issue where the column height setting reset to default when you select a "Next" button in the media history menu. 
 Fixed the issue where the scroll position resets when you select a "Next" button in the media history menu.
 Fixed the issue where returning the ring menu by pressing the menu button after opening the media history will cause a certain thumbnail to not display.
 Fixed the issue where some of the transform information is not saved when you leave a room right after you moved a subitem.

VCI
New Features

 Added ExportTransform.GetAttachedPlayer to VCI script, which will get the player id of the attached target of an attachable subitem.
 This API will return different user Ids in rooms and studios even if the user is the same.

 For details, see the  wiki reference (Japanese).

 In the room settings, the property "The user who can change the location" is removed. From now on, the owner and the administrators will have the static location change permission.

（Left: Global Stream Camera / Right: Local Stream Camera)

 Added [Global Stream Camera] and [Local Stream Camera] under the [Camera] menu in the ring menu.
 Global Stream Camera can only be spawned by the owner or the admin of the room you are in.
 A single Global Stream Camera can exist in a room. The video taken with this streaming camera will be shared with all users.
 Local Stream Camera is a streaming camera that can be spawned by anyone who has linked their THE SEED ONLINE account with VirtualCast.
 Room's owner and admin can also spawn a Local Stream Camera when they haven't spawned Global Stream Camera already.
 Local Stream Camera can be activated in the local environment, allowing you to switch the streaming video in your environment without affecting others.

How to Use the Stream Cameras

 For detail on how to use Stream Cameras, see the wiki (Japanese).
 Each stream camera can be activated by clicking the USE button shortly.
 A Stream Camera that is active will have its tally lamps at the top of the camera and the finder and the rings at the bottom lit.
 The video rendered on the monitor camera and the desktop window is the video taken from the active Stream Camera.
 You can click shortly on the monitor camera to activate it.
 Holding the USE button while grabbing a Stream Camera will make it go into Parallel Movement mode. Releasing the USE button will disengage the mode.
 Choosing [Parallel Movement] in the context menu will keep the Stream Camera in the Parallel Movement mode. In this mode, the pitch (X-axis) and roll (Z-axis) of the Stream Camera will be fixed to 0.
 The selection of the Parallel Movement mode is not synced across users and is not saved to the room.
 You can zoom with the Stream Camera by grabbing it with both hands and pulling out and in.
 When there are more than one Stream Cameras in a room, the room will get a [On Air] badge on their icon in the list of rooms. For details, see the wiki(Japanese).

 Unified the naming convention of images exported from whiteboard to that of images exported from capture camera.

    [/tr]
    [tr]

notes.title: VirtualCast Product Roadmap
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/3036ba785a6206754cdd28c5198bb2d41e838876.png
【VirtualCast】
October 2019
■Improved voice chat
Greatly reduces the jumpiness of the voice chat.

■Improved full-body tracking precision
Improves the precision of the motion capture when multiple trackers are used.

■Video capture feature
If you have a video capture device connected to your PC, you can see the video within VR.

■Quickly start VirtualCast from within HMD
You can start VirtualCast without complicated settings on the desktop screen. Just select Quick Start within VR and you are ready.

November 2019
■Addition of SHOWROOM gifts
You will be able to receive gifts thrown in SHOWROOM in VR as well.

■Limited time niconico live Vgift "School Fest(tentative)"
November exclusive Vgifts.

December 2019
■Major update "VirtualCast 2.0"
Addition of the following features and renewal of logo and design.

■My Room feature
Each user can have their own room.
My Room can be publicized so that users can open a long term exhibition and events.

■Improved UI
The Ring UI will be re-arranged based on current usage stats to improve usability. 
Title UI will also be re-adjusted so you can start VirtualCast more smoothly.

■Increased concurrent connection in a single room
Use polygon reduction feature of THE SEED ONLINE to lessen the graphical load when many users are connected in a single room.

■VR Time-shift feature
You can record the events happening in the VR space.
The recordings can be overlayed, providing a new way of enjoying VR.

Winter ~ Spring 2020
■Standalone HMD support
You will be able to play VirtualCast on VR devices that don't require a PC

■Spectate feature for PC
You will be able to spectate VirtualCast without using VR devices.

■Access THE SEED ONLINE from within the app
You will be able to access THE SEED ONLINE from within VR without using a Web browser and import or purchase items and avatars posted on THE SEED ONLINE directly.

【THE SEED ONLINE】
October 2019
■VRM polygon reduction feature
The number of polygons can be reduced depending on where the model is being exported.
This feature enables performance optimization based on the target platform, allowing for a larger number of attendees in a single VR space, optimization for smartphone apps, etc. Making THE SEED ONLINE integration much easier.

■VRM data encryption
Apply an encryption process to prevent unauthorized editing of models. Providing a safe environment for utilizing models in various applications.

December 2019
■SDK2 release
We will be releasing a new version of SDK incorporating the new features added in the October update, making implementation into application easier.

■Friend feature
You will be able to communicate and share among friends more easily.

Winter ~ Spring 2020
■Improved search
Finding what you want from loads of posted items becomes easier.

■Improved inventory organization system
Organize imported items more easily.

■In service currency
Introducing in service currency which can be used for trading items.

■User store feature
You can open up your own store and publish the items you created.

Read the article on PANORA for an in-depth interview with our officers explaining the future of VirtualCast (Japanese article).
